mapper.select: SELECT ppf.MATERIAL_CODE, ppf.MATERIAL_DESC, ppf.STRUCTURE_NAME AS GROUP_NAME, ppf.PRO_SIZE, ppf.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC AS EMBRYO_CODE, ppf.SPECIFICATIONS, ppf.MAIN_PATTERN, ppf.PATTERN, ppf.CX_MACHINE_CODE, ppf.DAY_VULCANIZATION_QTY, ppf.MOULD_CHANGE_INFO, ppf.DAY_${lastDay} AS PRODUCTION_QTY FROM t_mp_month_plan_prod_final ppf WHERE IFNULL(ppf.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND ppf.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ppf.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND ppf.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND ppf.DAY_${lastDay} > 0
